purpose: Bind an evidence-selected graph reverify ResponseIntent to the exact current runtime graph, registry, workspace subject, input tensor, candidate buffer, tolerances, and label without executing the graph or verifier.

upstream.serializable_dispatch_request: not used for runtime handles; ResponseDispatchRequest v1 intentionally keeps reverify deferred

exact_correspondence: current ResponseIntent and dispatch requirements must still be ready
workspace runtime subject must exactly equal the ResolutionEvidenceInbox target
selected source evidence must still exist at the ResponseIntent entry index
selected graph verifier evidence program identity is canonicalized at the host receipt-adapter boundary and must exactly equal the current CompiledGraph.programIdentity
current CompiledGraph must validate against the supplied LayerRegistry
subject-bound workspace must contain the exact current graph programIdentity
input tensor fingerprint and shape are derived from the supplied WasmTensor
candidate fingerprint and length are derived from the supplied f32 buffer
candidate values must be finite and non-empty
tolerances reuse the canonical comparator tolerance validator
label reuses the canonical verifier receipt label validator

binding_identity.binding_fingerprint: fnv1a64 over ResponseIntent/evidence/dispatch/requirements identity + exact graph program identity + input shape/fingerprint + candidate fingerprint/length + tolerance bits + label
binding_identity.security: deterministic correlation only; not authentication, authorization, or a capability token

recomputes: source evidence and program identity correspondence

invariants: a reverify intent cannot silently bind a different graph than the graph verifier evidence selected by the agent
runtime handles are inspected directly; caller-supplied string handle identities are not accepted
binding and preflight execute no graph numerics and allocate no verifier receipt
existing CompiledGraph.verifyFlat and workspaceVerifyGraphReceipt remain the canonical verifier authorities
the binding does not mutate ResolutionEvidenceInbox, Resolution state, AgentWorkspace, CompiledGraph, LayerRegistry, input tensor, or candidate buffer
mutable learned state is not silently promoted into programIdentity; exact learned-state snapshotting remains a separate concern

next_boundary.rule: execution consumes a current ready binding plus the same real runtime handles, invokes workspaceVerifyGraphReceipt, and returns a correlated result whose canonical verifier receipt may rejoin only through a separate explicit call

registry_state_policy.rationale: CompiledGraph programIdentity intentionally represents structure/init identity rather than mutable learned state. Reverify is allowed to observe current registry weights at execution time.
registry_state_policy.preflight: validates current graph/registry structural binding but does not freeze or hash mutable learned weights
registry_state_policy.consequence: compatible learned-weight changes do not invalidate the binding solely because weights changed; the eventual verifier result reflects the live state

program_identity_transport.receipt_adapter: RuntimeEvidence.from_graph_verifier_receipt_json validates the structured graph identity and projects it into the canonical CompiledGraph.programIdentity field order
program_identity_transport.runtime_binding: uses exact string equality after canonical host projection; no serde_json dependency is introduced into the WASM runtime
program_identity_transport.rationale: preserve cross-target minimal dependencies while avoiding JSON object key-order false negatives
